name: Proving Grounds - moves, anchors, then fires with AOE
notes: Mario's sixth requested design. The crawler marches until its targets are within its range 6, then attack.windupTicks holds its first shot for 30 ticks - spent only while it is genuinely in firing position, never while marching - before attack.splash (the detonation {radius,damage} shape, reused as an attack) lands on the wall segment it aims at and the one beside it at once instead of one at a time (a radius of 2 is two columns either side and one row up and down). The targets are two wall segments, one on the row below the other, because they stand: troopers that walk at it spread round it since pathfinding, and no longer queue in single file for the shell to catch two. Watch the gap in the headless log between the last move.intended and the first attack.launched: that gap is the windup, not the travel time.
